primary_source.citation: T. Juskevicius and J. D. Lee, Small ball probabilities, maximum density and rearrangements, arXiv:1503.09190, Theorem 1
primary_source.hypothesis_match: independent bounded-density real summands; deterministic scaling of arbitrary cap-one original variables; no moments, iid, support, log-concavity, smoothness, centering, or symmetry required

partner_result_actually_applied.result: random-slope kernel ||p_(aU^2+bU+2tV)||_infinity <= min((2|t|)^(-1),sqrt(2/(|a||t|))) for independent cap-one U,V

new_claims.statement: For T=2UH+aV^2+B(Z)V+C(Z), with U,V,Z_j mutually independent cap-one and H=eta+sum g_j Z_j, ||p_T||_infinity <= E H_a(sum g_j U_j^*) where U_j^* are iid centered unit uniforms and H_a(x)=min((2|x|)^(-1),sqrt(2/(|a||x|))); the density is continuous C0.

For Q_theta=2(X0+theta(X1-X2)/sqrt2)(X1+X2)/sqrt2+X3^2, arbitrary independent cap-one inputs and theta real, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 1/12+sqrt2+(5sqrt2/2)log2 = 3.9481922543777963..., and p_Q is continuous C0.

unresolved_implication: Retain the genuinely nonzero tiny hub edge in the heavy null-hub collar q_i>1/2, 0<|g_i|<1/64, and derive a product-provenance receiver with a coefficient-sensitive even decreasing slope kernel, or route to another paid branch. The global structural bridge remains open.
